inspection.scope: Full flavon/driving field table and seesaw change; quark/stabilization completion kept explicit.
inspection.coverage_note: These are passages and model-definition sections actually inspected, not a claim that every sentence on each page or the entire PDF was read. Field claims are retained separately in field-evidence.json; legacy records remain unchecked reference material.

claims.value: Source-explicit SM/MSSM inheritance is expanded using the declared atlas baseline: three ordinary SM chiral families, no independent RH neutrino unless stated. Exact Dynkin and all-LH conversion are conventions/derivations, not newly printed source tables. Gauge connections and dependent conjugates are not extra matter.

SUSY lepton construction has flavon triplets phiT,phiS, singlets xi,xitilde, driving triplets phiT0,phiS0 and driving singlet xi0. These are chiral gauge singlets; A4 triplet means three copies with respect to continuous gauge algebra, not a new gauge factor. FN flavon theta is also a gauge singlet, with additional stabilization matter discussed as optional.
Seesaw variant adds three gauge-singlet chiral nu^c to the effective-operator version; the driving part is unchanged. Source nu^c is already LH-conjugate notation.

source_descriptions.reason: FN theta/stabilization and source quark extension are not fixed to one full accepted spectrum; no matter invented to complete them.
